# Rules for Responsible Modeling

> Interactive urban drainage modeling lessons, a real browser SWMM engine and a fictional worked case by Robert Dickinson.

## Documentation
- [Technical summary](/index.md): Computation, engine provenance, inputs, checks, limitations, reproduction, credits and AI use for the whole application, including its micro-apps.

## Pages
- [About the author and app](/about-author): Book background, app credits, technical summary and AI disclosure.
- [What's New](/whats-new): Dated development history.
- [Review Log](/grade-report): Outside reviewer findings and unresolved limitations.
- [Micro-Apps](/micro-apps): Public index of chapter-related educational tools covered by the application summary.
- [SWMM Playground](/playground): Local simulation, model builder and uncertainty charts.
- [Worked case](/worked-case): Fictional calibration, validation and uncertainty exercise.
